title: Verification and Reconstruction of a Claimed Complex Structure on S6: An AI-Produced Validate/Repair/Disprove Record
description: This record presents an AI-produced mathematical verification and reconstruction audit of a reported candidate compact complex threefold diffeomorphic to the six-sphere. The primary monograph combines a mathematical orientation with the complete validate/repair/disprove workbench; supplements provide the source reconstruction, review records, exact certificates, reproducibility materials, a curated mathematical chronology, and a separately validated complete sanitized human/assistant conversation record. Claims are labelled VERIFIED, OPEN, or REFUTED according to the proofs and counterexamples recorded in the monograph. Those labels do not constitute conventional journal peer review, independent specialist certification, or community acceptance. The candidate and its original claims remain attributed to their reported Claude/Fabel source, and this deposit makes no priority claim. Independent specialist replication and external adjudication remain open. Third-party literature is cited but not bundled; the private raw session record is not deposited.
